## Report: Official-Tier Approval Workflow — Existing Architecture

### 1. DB Schema: Reviewer Matrix

**Files:**
- `/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/shared/db/schema/approval.ts` — approval requests and reviewer assignments
- `/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/shared/db/schema/extension.ts` (lines 50–53) — `officialTierEnum`
- `/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/shared/db/schema/org.ts` (lines 14–21) — `membershipRoleEnum`

**Key tables:**
- **`approvalReviewers`** (approval.ts:57–78): Indexed by `(tier, subCat, userId)` with unique constraint. Stores reviewer-to-cell assignments. Columns: `id`, `tier` (enum: `productLine|company`), `subCat` (text, drawn from FUNC_TAXONOMY.l1), `userId`, `createdAt`.
- **`approvalRequests`** (approval.ts:20–55): Captures elevation requests. Columns: `requestedTier`, `subCat` (snapshot at submission time), `status` (pending|approved|rejected|withdrawn).
- **`extensions.officialTier`** (extension.ts:89): Enum column (`productLine|company`), null by default. Written only by approval orchestrator on approve.
- **`membershipRoleEnum`** (org.ts:14–21): Values include `superAdmin` — the gate for matrix edits. Comment notes: "Super-admins can edit the approval reviewer matrix and decide on any approval request regardless of cell assignment. Seeded; not granted via UI."

### 2. FUNC_TAXONOMY & Product-Line Concepts

**File:** `/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/shared/taxonomy.ts`

The taxonomy defines three top-level `funcCat` categories and nine `subCat` (l1 leaves):
```typescript
FUNC_TAXONOMY: [
  { key: "workTask", l1: [ systemDesign, softDev, testing ] },
  { key: "business", l1: [ network, embedded, cloud ] },
  { key: "tools", l1: [ docs, data, vcs ] }
]
```

**No product-line concept currently exists in the codebase.** Wireless, Datacom, Terminals, and Cloud are not present as enums, tables, or columns.

### 3. Matrix-Editing UI & Endpoints

**Server endpoints:**
- `/server/api/internal/admin/reviewers/index.get.ts` — `requireSuperAdmin` gate; calls `listMatrix(db)` to return full reviewer assignments joined with user display fields.
- `/server/api/internal/admin/reviewers/assign.post.ts` — validates input via `AssignReviewerSchema` (tier + subCat + userId), gates on `requireSuperAdmin`, inserts via `insertReviewer(db, ...)`.
- `/server/api/internal/admin/reviewers/unassign.delete.ts` — (inferred) deletes a reviewer assignment.

**Repository helpers** (`server/repositories/reviewers.ts`):
- `listMatrix()` — full reviewer list, ordered by `(tier, subCat, email)`.
- `listCellsForUser(userId)` — returns `{ tier, subCat }` pairs a user is assigned to.
- `findReviewersFor(tier, subCat)` — returns user IDs for a given cell.
- `insertReviewer()`, `deleteReviewer()`.
- `isSuperAdmin(userId)` — checks if any membership has `role='superAdmin'`.

**Permission gate:** The `requireSuperAdmin` middleware (called at the start of assign/unassign endpoints) restricts matrix edits to super-admins only.

### 4. Approval Routing Logic

**File:** `/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/server/utils/approvals.ts`

When a publisher submits a request, `submitRequest(params)` writes to `approvalRequests` with `(requestedTier, subCat)` snapshot.

When a reviewer decides, `decideRequest(params)` checks authorization:
- If `isSuperAdmin(reviewerUserId)` → allowed (bypass cell check).
- Else → call `isReviewerForCell(db, userId, tier, subCat)` against `approvalReviewers`. Only assigned reviewers can decide on their cells.

The reviewer queue (`listReviewerQueue(userId)`) loads `listCellsForUser(userId)` to find pending requests in those cells. Super-admins see the entire pending queue.

**File:** `/server/repositories/approvals.ts` (line 247–265): `isReviewerForCell(db, userId, tier, subCat)` — query against `approvalReviewers` table with three-way join condition.

### 5. `/api/v1` Badge Derivation

**File:** `/server/api/v1/extensions/index.get.ts` (lines 35–38):
```typescript
// Preserve the frozen /api/v1 contract: any officialTier surfaces as
// `badge: "official"`. The new tier dimension stays internal until
// a contract bump intentionally exposes it.
badge: ext.officialTier ? "official" : ext.badge,
```

The `officialTier` column (internal) is mapped to the public `badge` field at the response boundary. If `officialTier` is non-null, the CLI sees `badge="official"` regardless of tier value.

### 6. ADR Content (Key Sections)

**File:** `/docs/adr/0001-official-tier-approval-workflow.md`

**Decision summary:**
1. **Category = `subCat`** — Matrix is `9 subCats × 2 tiers = 18` cells.
2. **Tiers are independent** — publisher picks target tier at submit; no mandatory PL→Company ladder.
3. **`officialTier` is its own enum column** — not folded into `badge`. Derived to `"official"` badge in `/api/v1` mappers to preserve the frozen CLI contract.
4. **Matrix admin = `superAdmin` role only** — new enum value in `membershipRoleEnum`. Super-admins can edit cells and bypass cell-assignment checks.

**Consequences noted:**
- Duplication: two related columns (`officialTier` + `badge`), bridged by derive-in-mapper.
- Independent-tier model allows day-one Company requests (no PL prerequisite).
- Super-admin concentration risk; production must seed `SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL`.

**Open follow-ups (not implemented):**
- Tier revocation.
- Notification fan-out (events emitted but no email/in-app consumer yet).
- Audit trail for matrix edits.

### 7. Tests

**Integration tests:** `/tests/integration/repositories/approvals.test.ts` (13 KB) covers:
- `insertRequest` + `findById`
- `findPendingByExtension`
- `listPendingForCells` (cell-based queue filtering)
- `applyDecision` (optimistic locking on status transition)
- Bulk lookups (`findTiersForExtensions`, `findPendingForExtensions`)

**E2E tests:** `/tests/e2e/approval.spec.ts` covers:
- Filter rail SSR (official-tier pill labels).
- Auth redirects on `/en/admin/approvals` and `/en/admin/reviewers`.
- Query param survival (`?tier=productLine`).
- Multi-actor golden path (gated on `RUN_FULL_E2E`): publisher submits → reviewer assigned → reviewer approves → badge appears.

**Unit tests:** Pure state logic in `/shared/approvals/state.ts` — `decideApprovalOutcome` and `decideWithdrawOutcome` are testable without DB.

---

**Summary for your enhancement:** The matrix today is keyed by `(tier × subCat)` in the `approvalReviewers` table. To add product-line scoping, you'll need to:
1. Add a `productLineId` column to `approvalReviewers` and update the unique constraint to `(tier, subCat, productLineId, userId)`.
2. Introduce a product-line enum or reference (new table or enum in schema).
3. Update validators, endpoints, and repository queries to thread `productLineId` through submission and reviewer assignment flows.
4. Adjust the Company Official tier logic to allow per-subCat super-admins to manage product-line admins for that subCat.

# Plan: Product-Line Dimension for the Official-Tier Approval Workflow

## 0. Scope summary

Extend the existing `(tier × subCat)` reviewer matrix with a third dimension — a `productLine` — that applies only to the `productLine` tier. Company-tier cells stay shape-identical to today. The dimension is data-driven (a `product_lines` table) so adding/removing lines is a content change, not a code release. Permission gating fans out so each company-tier admin can self-manage productLine reviewers for the same subCat.

Locked v1 invariants kept:

- `/api/v1` `badge` mapper unchanged (`officialTier IS NOT NULL → "official"`).
- Tiers remain independent (no PL → Company ladder).
- `officialTier` stays its own enum column.
- Filter UI stays "single-row quiet pill rail" (decision #3).

---

## 1. Database — migration `0009_product_line_dimension.sql`

### 1.1 New table `product_lines`

Mirrors the `tags` table shape (per locked decision #10 for bilingual lookup tables).

```sql
CREATE TABLE "product_lines" (
  "id"          text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,          -- kebab-case: 'wireless', 'datacom', 'terminals', 'cloud'
  "label_en"    text NOT NULL,
  "label_zh"    text NOT NULL,
  "sort_order"  integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at"  timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
INSERT INTO "product_lines" ("id","label_en","label_zh","sort_order") VALUES
  ('wireless',  'Wireless',  '无线',     10),
  ('datacom',   'Datacom',   '数通',     20),
  ('terminals', 'Terminals', '终端',     30),
  ('cloud',     'Cloud',     '云',       40);
```

### 1.2 Schema diff on the three tier-aware tables

```sql
ALTER TABLE "approval_reviewers"
  ADD COLUMN "product_line_id" text REFERENCES "product_lines"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT;

ALTER TABLE "approval_requests"
  ADD COLUMN "product_line_id" text REFERENCES "product_lines"("id") ON DELETE RESTRICT;

ALTER TABLE "extensions"
  ADD COLUMN "product_line_id" text REFERENCES "product_lines"("id") ON DELETE SET NULL;
CREATE INDEX "idx_ext_product_line" ON "extensions" ("product_line_id");
```

`ON DELETE RESTRICT` on the two approval tables keeps history honest — you cannot disappear a productLine that an approval references; deprecation is a soft state (drop from picker, leave row). On `extensions` we permit `SET NULL` so an admin can retire a line without orphaning content; the `officialTier` field is the load-bearing "official" signal, not productLine.

### 1.3 Per-table CHECK invariants

The shape rule is the same on all three: `product_line_id` is required iff `tier`/`requested_tier`/`official_tier` equals `'productLine'`.

```sql
ALTER TABLE "approval_reviewers" ADD CONSTRAINT "approval_reviewers_pl_shape_chk"
  CHECK (
    (tier = 'productLine' AND product_line_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR (tier = 'company'  AND product_line_id IS NULL)
  );

ALTER TABLE "approval_requests" ADD CONSTRAINT "approval_requests_pl_shape_chk"
  CHECK (
    (requested_tier = 'productLine' AND product_line_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR (requested_tier = 'company'  AND product_line_id IS NULL)
  );

ALTER TABLE "extensions" ADD CONSTRAINT "extensions_pl_shape_chk"
  CHECK (
    official_tier IS NULL                                -- unofficial: anything goes
    OR (official_tier = 'productLine' AND product_line_id IS NOT NULL)
    OR (official_tier = 'company'     AND product_line_id IS NULL)
  );
```

These are the single source of truth for the shape rule. Validators, repositories, and orchestrator can rely on them as a hard backstop and only need to surface friendly errors at the boundary.

### 1.4 Tier-aware uniqueness on `approval_reviewers` — recommendation

**Drop** `approval_reviewers_cell_user_unique (tier, sub_cat, user_id)` and replace with **two partial unique indexes**:

```sql
ALTER TABLE "approval_reviewers" DROP CONSTRAINT "approval_reviewers_cell_user_unique";

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "approval_reviewers_pl_cell_user_uq"
  ON "approval_reviewers" ("tier", "sub_cat", "product_line_id", "user_id")
  WHERE tier = 'productLine';

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "approval_reviewers_co_cell_user_uq"
  ON "approval_reviewers" ("tier", "sub_cat", "user_id")
  WHERE tier = 'company';
```

Why partial indexes over `NULLS NOT DISTINCT`:

- The two tiers have *different* arity — productLine cells use four columns, company cells three. With `NULLS NOT DISTINCT` we'd still have to carry the same four columns and just trust that `product_line_id` is always NULL on company rows. The CHECK already gives us that; the index then duplicates the constraint cosmetically.
- Partial indexes are self-documenting in `\d`. A reviewer reading the schema sees "two cell shapes" instead of "one shape with a quirky NULL rule."
- Both PG14- and PG15+ deploys behave identically. Drizzle 0.30 fully supports `pgIndex().where(...)`.
- The existing index `idx_approval_reviewers_cell` continues to support cell lookups; add a `where tier='productLine'` variant only if profiling shows the productLine list query hot-spots.

Mirror the same pattern on `approval_requests` only at the `idx_approval_status_cell` reviewer-queue index — replace it with two partial indexes that include `product_line_id` on the productLine variant, so the queue scan stays a single index path.

## 2. Drizzle schema updates

### 2.1 `shared/db/schema/extension.ts` — new table

Add `productLines` table next to `tags` (it's the closest analogue):

```ts
export const productLines = pgTable("product_lines", {
  id: text().primaryKey(),
  labelEn: text().notNull(),
  labelZh: text().notNull(),
  sortOrder: integer().notNull().default(0),
  createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
})
```

Add `productLineId` to `extensions`, plus the CHECK and index. Use Drizzle's `sql` template for the CHECK predicate.

### 2.2 `shared/db/schema/approval.ts`

Add `productLineId` columns to both tables. Replace the `unique()` constructor with two `uniqueIndex(...).where(sql\`...\`)` declarations. Add CHECK constraint via `check("approval_reviewers_pl_shape_chk", sql\`...\`)`.

### 2.3 `shared/db/schema/index.ts`

Export `productLines` (re-exports cascade automatically through `extension.ts`).

## 3. Validators — `shared/validators/approvals.ts` & `shared/validators/filters.ts`

### 3.1 Shared productLine key validator

Source of truth: a runtime list fetched from the DB. For validation, just do a string shape check (`z.string().trim().regex(/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/).min(1).max(40)`). The DB FK + CHECK does the membership check; trying to encode the full enum in the validator would defeat the "data-driven" point.

### 3.2 `SubmitApprovalSchema`

```ts
const ProductLineId = z.string().trim().min(1).max(40)

export const SubmitApprovalSchema = z.object({
  extensionId: z.string().trim().min(1),
  requestedTier: OfficialTier,
  subCat: SubCatKey,
  productLineId: ProductLineId.optional(),
  reason: optionalText(APPROVAL_REASON_MAX),
}).refine(
  (v) => v.requestedTier === "productLine" ? !!v.productLineId : !v.productLineId,
  { path: ["productLineId"], message: "productLineId is required iff requestedTier=productLine" },
)
```

### 3.3 `AssignReviewerSchema`

Same refine pattern:

```ts
export const AssignReviewerSchema = z.object({
  tier: OfficialTier,
  subCat: SubCatKey,
  productLineId: ProductLineId.optional(),
  userId: z.string().trim().min(1),
}).refine(
  (v) => v.tier === "productLine" ? !!v.productLineId : !v.productLineId,
  { path: ["productLineId"], message: "productLineId is required iff tier=productLine" },
)
```

`UnassignReviewerSchema` is unchanged — deletion is by row id.

### 3.4 `filtersSchema`

Add `productLineId: z.string().trim().min(1).max(40).optional()`. Serializer/deserializer already iterates `Object.entries`, no changes needed. Search URL becomes `?tier=productLine&productLineId=wireless`.

## 4. Repositories & orchestrator

### 4.1 `server/repositories/reviewers.ts`

Widen `ReviewerRow` and `InsertReviewerRow` with `productLineId: string | null`. Update:

- `listMatrix()` — select `productLineId`; order by `(tier, subCat, productLineId NULLS FIRST, email)`.
- `listCellsForUser(userId)` — returns `{ tier, subCat, productLineId: string | null }[]`.
- `findReviewersFor(db, tier, subCat, productLineId?)` — `eq(approvalReviewers.productLineId, productLineId)` when productLine tier, otherwise `isNull(approvalReviewers.productLineId)`.
- `insertReviewer` — drop the `onConflictDoNothing` target list; with two partial unique indexes Drizzle's typed conflict target is awkward — use `onConflictDoNothing()` without a target (the partial indexes still de-dupe). The CHECK enforces shape.
- New `isCompanyAdminForSubCat(db, userId, subCat) -> boolean` — `select 1 from approval_reviewers where userId=? and tier='company' and subCat=? limit 1`.

### 4.2 `server/repositories/approvals.ts`

- Extend `ApprovalRequestRow` / `InsertApprovalRequest` / `fullSelect` with `productLineId`.
- `listPendingForCells(db, cells)` — cells now carry `productLineId: string | null`; the `cellMatches` predicate becomes `and(tier=, subCat=, productLine_id IS NULL or =)`. Keep building one big OR over (tier, subCat, productLineId) triples so the partial index on `approval_requests` is used.
- `isReviewerForCell(db, userId, tier, subCat, productLineId?)` — gain optional fourth arg; on productLine, require an `eq(approvalReviewers.productLineId, productLineId)`; on company, `isNull(...)`.
- `setExtensionOfficialTier` becomes `setExtensionOfficialTier(db, extId, tier, productLineId | null)` and updates `productLineId` on the row in lockstep. The CHECK enforces the shape rule (passing `'company'` with non-null productLineId rejects at the DB).

### 4.3 New `server/repositories/productLines.ts`

```ts
export interface ProductLineRow { id: string; labelEn: string; labelZh: string; sortOrder: number }
export async function listAllProductLines(db: Transactable): Promise<ProductLineRow[]>
export async function existsProductLine(db: Transactable, id: string): Promise<boolean>
```

Cache list with `defineCachedFunction` from Nitro (5-min TTL) — the seed list churns rarely.

### 4.4 `server/utils/approvals.ts`

- `SubmitParams` gains `productLineId: string | null`. Add an early sanity check: if `requestedTier === 'productLine'` and `!productLineId`, throw `ApprovalError("missing_product_line")` (new error code). Pass through to `insertRequest`.
- `decideRequest` — when looking up the cell for `isReviewerForCell`, pass `current.productLineId`. After approval, `setExtensionOfficialTier(tx, current.extensionId, outcome.extension.officialTier, current.productLineId)`.
- `listReviewerQueue` — super-admin fan-out now flattens cells by `(tier, subCat, productLineId)`; non-super uses `listCellsForUser(userId)` verbatim.

Add new error codes to `ApprovalErrorCode`: `missing_product_line`, `not_company_admin`. Map the latter from the admin endpoints.

## 5. Permission model

Replace `requireSuperAdmin` on the matrix mutation endpoints with a cell-aware `requireCellAdmin(event, { tier, subCat, productLineId? })`:

```ts
// in server/utils/auth.ts (or alongside requireSuperAdmin)
export async function requireCellAdmin(event, cell): Promise<UserContext> {
  const user = await requireUser(event)
  const db = useDb()
  if (await isSuperAdmin(db, user.id)) return user
  if (cell.tier === "productLine"
      && await isCompanyAdminForSubCat(db, user.id, cell.subCat)) {
    return user
  }
  throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: "not_authorized" })
}
```

Endpoint changes:

- `assign.post.ts` / `unassign.delete.ts` — call `requireCellAdmin(event, { tier, subCat, productLineId })`. For `unassign`, first load the row to learn its `(tier, subCat, productLineId)` then gate. This catches the "company admin tries to remove a *company* reviewer" case.
- `index.get.ts` — relax to "any super-admin OR any user with at least one row in `approval_reviewers`". Returned payload annotates each cell with `canEdit: boolean`:

```ts
return {
  ok: true,
  productLines: await listAllProductLines(db),
  reviewers: rows.map(r => ({ ...r, canEdit: computeCanEdit(r, user) })),
  // also expose the viewer's own role flags so the UI can hide tabs
  viewer: { isSuperAdmin, companySubCats: [...] },
}
```

`computeCanEdit` is: super-admin → true everywhere; otherwise productLine cell whose `subCat ∈ viewer.companySubCats` → true; otherwise false.

The `submit.post.ts` endpoint stays publisher-gated as today; the new productLineId is just an additional field.

- `ReviewerMatrixProductLine.vue` — a 2-D grid: rows are subCats, columns are productLines (rendered in `sortOrder`). Each cell carries reviewer chips + an "+" button.

Both subcomponents take `canEdit` per cell and grey/disable the chip controls when false. The "remove" X is hidden on non-editable cells.

Replace the static `t(\`extensions.officialTier.${officialTier}\`)` with:

Mounted in the existing filter rail wherever `OfficialTierPill` is — wrap them in a `<div class="flex items-center gap-2">` so the new picker appears immediately to the right.

`useFilters` composable + `serializeFilters` already plumb arbitrary keys through; just add `productLineId` to the typed shape.

### 6.6 Listing query plumbing

`shared/search/query.ts` — append:

filters.productLineId
  ? eq(extensions.productLineId, filters.productLineId)

This works regardless of `tier` value: a user filtering by `productLineId=wireless` without `tier=productLine` still gets all "Wireless" extensions (could be company-tier too in the future, but the CHECK currently disallows that — so today it just narrows to Wireless productLine officials).

## 10. Documentation

**Recommendation: extend ADR-0001 with a dated addendum rather than open ADR-0002.**

Reasons:

- The change does not reverse any of the four locked decisions in ADR-0001; it refines decision #1 ("Category = `subCat`") to "(`subCat`, `productLine` when productLine tier)" and tightens decision #4 ("Matrix admin") with a delegation rule. The earlier decisions remain accurate as written.
- The split-ADR pattern is best when revoking an earlier one; an addendum keeps the *complete* reasoning in one document, which is easier for new readers.
- ADR-0001 already lists "Open follow-ups" — this is one of them being closed.

- Why partial indexes over `NULLS NOT DISTINCT`.
- The company-admin → productLine-admin delegation rule.
- Confirm `/api/v1` contract still frozen.
- Cross-link the new migration and the productLines table.

> 12. **Official-tier approval workflow**: extensions default to Unofficial; elevation to Product-Line Official or Company Official goes through a reviewer matrix indexed by `(tier × FUNC_TAXONOMY subCat)`, additionally keyed by `productLine` (data-driven table; current rows: wireless, datacom, terminals, cloud) for the `productLine` tier only. Tiers are independent (no PL→Company ladder); `officialTier` lives in its own enum column; the `/api/v1` `badge` field is read-derived from it to preserve the frozen CLI contract. Matrix edits: super-admins everywhere; company-tier admins of a given subCat can manage productLine-tier admins for the same subCat. Full rationale and trade-offs in `docs/adr/0001-official-tier-approval-workflow.md` (incl. 2026-06-08 update).

## 11. Commit/PR split

Per CLAUDE.md ("Commit per coherent unit … one or several commits per phase"). Suggested phases / commits on a single feature branch, one PR:

1. `feat(p9-db): add product_lines table and product_line_id columns` — migration `0009_*`, drizzle schema, partial unique indexes, CHECK constraints, seed inside the migration. **No app code change yet.**
2. `feat(p9-repo): thread productLineId through reviewers + approvals repositories` — repo signature/field additions, new `isCompanyAdminForSubCat`, new `productLines` repo.

## Approved Plan:
# Plan: Product-Line dimension for the Official-Tier approval workflow

## Context

PR #41 landed the (tier × subCat) reviewer matrix. The company is organised in multiple product lines (Wireless, Datacom, Terminals, Cloud) and each *functional category* inside each product line needs its own reviewer admin. Additionally, the **Company Official** admin of a subCat should be able to configure the **Product-Line Official** admins for the same subCat — a delegation that the current single-`superAdmin` gate cannot express.

This enhancement adds a `productLine` dimension that applies **only to the `productLine` tier**:

- Reviewer matrix becomes `(tier × subCat × productLine?)` — productLine is required iff `tier='productLine'`.
- Approval requests + extension `officialTier` carry the same conditional `productLineId`.
- Matrix-edit permission fans out: super-admin everywhere; company-tier admin of subCat *X* can manage productLine cells of subCat *X*.
- `/api/v1` contract is unchanged (`badge` still derives `officialTier IS NOT NULL → "official"`).
- Tiers stay independent — no PL→Company ladder.

User decisions captured upstream:
1. Product lines are stored as a **seeded DB table** (`product_lines`), not a code enum.
2. **Single** product line per extension. Multi-line endorsement is a future change.
3. The listing filter rail gets an **inline product-line picker**, surfaced only when `tier=productLine`.

## Schema (drizzle + migration `0009_*`)

### New table `product_lines` (mirrors the `tags` bilingual lookup shape, per decision #10)

| column | type | notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `text PK` | kebab-case: `wireless`, `datacom`, `terminals`, `cloud` |
| `label_en` / `label_zh` | `text not null` | bilingual labels |
| `sort_order` | `integer not null default 0` | pill ordering |
| `created_at` | `timestamptz not null default now()` | |

Seed all four rows in the same migration.

### Add `product_line_id` FK to three existing tables

- `approval_reviewers.product_line_id` → `product_lines.id` `ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `approval_requests.product_line_id` → `product_lines.id` `ON DELETE RESTRICT`
- `extensions.product_line_id` → `product_lines.id` `ON DELETE SET NULL` (+ index)

`RESTRICT` on the audit-trail tables keeps history honest; `SET NULL` on extensions lets an admin retire a line without orphaning content.

### Shape invariant — CHECK on each table

```sql
-- pattern, mirrored on approval_reviewers, approval_requests, extensions
CHECK (
  (<tier_col> = 'productLine' AND product_line_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (<tier_col> = 'company'  AND product_line_id IS NULL)
  -- extensions also allows `<tier_col> IS NULL` (unofficial)
)
```

### Tier-aware uniqueness on `approval_reviewers`

Drop the existing 3-column unique and replace with **two partial unique indexes** (clearer than `NULLS NOT DISTINCT`, both partial indexes are self-documenting in `\d`, and the two tiers really have different arity):

```sql
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX approval_reviewers_pl_cell_user_uq
  ON approval_reviewers (tier, sub_cat, product_line_id, user_id)
  WHERE tier = 'productLine';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX approval_reviewers_co_cell_user_uq
  ON approval_reviewers (tier, sub_cat, user_id)
  WHERE tier = 'company';
```

Mirror the same split on the `idx_approval_status_cell` reviewer-queue index over `approval_requests` so the queue scan stays one index path.

## Validators (`shared/validators/`)

- `SubmitApprovalSchema` (approvals.ts): add `productLineId: ProductLineId.optional()` + a `.refine(...)` that requires it iff `requestedTier === 'productLine'`.
- `AssignReviewerSchema` (approvals.ts): same refine pattern.
- `filtersSchema` (filters.ts): add `productLineId` optional string. The existing `Object.entries` serializer needs no changes — `?tier=productLine&productLineId=wireless` round-trips automatically.

`ProductLineId` is a shape check (`/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`, length-bounded). The DB FK + CHECK does membership.

## Repositories & orchestrator

- `server/repositories/reviewers.ts` — widen `ReviewerRow`/`InsertReviewerRow` with `productLineId: string | null`; thread through `listMatrix`, `listCellsForUser`, `findReviewersFor(... productLineId?)`, `insertReviewer`. **New** `isCompanyAdminForSubCat(db, userId, subCat) → boolean`.
- `server/repositories/approvals.ts` — add `productLineId` to `ApprovalRequestRow` / `fullSelect`; update `listPendingForCells` cell predicate to include productLine; extend `isReviewerForCell` with optional `productLineId`. `setExtensionOfficialTier(db, extId, tier, productLineId | null)` updates both columns together.
- `server/repositories/productLines.ts` — **new** repo: `listAllProductLines`, `existsProductLine`. Wrap `listAllProductLines` with Nitro `defineCachedFunction` (5-min TTL) — list churns rarely.
- `server/utils/approvals.ts` — `SubmitParams` gains `productLineId`; orchestrator validates the iff-rule (new error code `missing_product_line`), `decideRequest` passes `current.productLineId` into the cell check and stamps both columns. New error code `not_company_admin` for the relaxed admin gate.

## Permission model

Replace blanket `requireSuperAdmin` on the matrix mutation endpoints with **`requireCellAdmin(event, { tier, subCat, productLineId? })`**:

- super-admin → allowed on any cell
- otherwise allowed iff `tier === 'productLine'` AND `isCompanyAdminForSubCat(user, subCat)`
- company-tier cells stay super-admin-only

`unassign.delete.ts` loads the target row first (so it can authorise against that row's tier/subCat).

`reviewers/index.get.ts` relaxes to "super-admin OR any user with at least one row in `approval_reviewers`" and returns per-cell `canEdit` plus a `viewer` block (`isSuperAdmin`, `companySubCats`) so the UI can grey non-editable cells. The list of product lines is included in the same response (one fewer round-trip).

## API endpoints

| route | change |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/internal/product-lines` | **new** — returns the seeded list, signed-in users, Nitro-cached |
| `GET /api/internal/admin/reviewers` | relaxed auth + `canEdit` + `viewer` + `productLines` in payload |
| `POST /api/internal/admin/reviewers/assign` | `requireCellAdmin`; `productLineId` honoured per shape rule |
| `DELETE /api/internal/admin/reviewers/unassign` | load row, then `requireCellAdmin` |
| `POST /api/internal/approvals/submit` | validator requires `productLineId` iff tier=productLine |
| `GET /api/v1/extensions/*` | **no contract change** — `badge` mapper untouched. Add a one-line comment near `server/api/v1/extensions/index.get.ts:38` noting the internal `productLineId` field is intentionally suppressed. |
| listing internal endpoints | thread `productLineId` filter (mechanical, via `parseFilters`) |

## UI changes

- `app/components/approvals/RequestOfficialDialog.vue` — when `tier=productLine`, show a productLine `<select>` (driven by `useFetch('/api/internal/product-lines')`); clear on tier toggle; gate submit until set.
- `app/components/approvals/ReviewerMatrix.vue` — split into a tabbed shell over two presentational subcomponents:
  - `ReviewerMatrixCompany.vue` — current (subCat × admins) shape, one column collapsed.
  - `ReviewerMatrixProductLine.vue` — 2-D grid (rows = subCats, columns = productLines in `sortOrder`).
  Both consume `canEdit` per cell and disable controls when false. Persist active tab in URL hash.
- `app/components/approvals/ReviewerQueueTable.vue` — show productLine label as a third badge after subCat when present.
- `app/components/extension/ExtHero.vue` — for `officialTier='productLine'`, render the product-line label (`"Wireless Official"` / `"无线官方"`) via a new i18n key `extensions.officialTier.productLineWith` interpolated with `{line}`. Extension detail loader joins `product_lines` to provide the label.
- `app/components/filters/` — **new** `ProductLinePill.vue` sibling to `OfficialTierPill.vue`, only renders when `filters.tier === 'productLine'`, single-row pill style per decision #3.
- `shared/search/query.ts` — append `eq(extensions.productLineId, filters.productLineId)` when set.

## Tests

- `tests/integration/repositories/reviewers.test.ts` — CHECK rejects missing/extra productLineId, partial-index dedup behaves per tier, `isCompanyAdminForSubCat`, `findReviewersFor` with/without productLineId.
- `tests/integration/repositories/approvals.test.ts` — request insert+find round-trip productLineId, `listPendingForCells` honours per-cell productLine, `setExtensionOfficialTier` stamps both columns.
- Orchestrator tests — `submitRequest` rejects missing productLineId on productLine tier; `decideRequest` super-admin path; non-super reviewer assigned to `(productLine, cloud, wireless)` approves matching request; same reviewer on `(... datacom)` request → `not_reviewer`.
- `tests/e2e/approval.spec.ts` — extend SSR round-trip with `?tier=productLine&productLineId=wireless`; add gated multi-actor path (company admin of `cloud` assigns a productLine reviewer, reviewer approves a wireless request, detail page badge = "Wireless Official"); add negative (company admin of `cloud` blocked on `(productLine, network, wireless)` assign, 403 + greyed cell).
- New `tests/unit/components/ReviewerMatrixProductLine.spec.ts`.
- Update existing approval submit/integration tests to pass `productLineId` where required.

## Documentation

- Extend `docs/adr/0001-official-tier-approval-workflow.md` with a **2026-06-08 addendum** (the change refines, does not revoke — keeps reasoning in one doc):
  - new productLine dimension and data-driven table
  - rationale for partial indexes over `NULLS NOT DISTINCT`
  - company-admin → productLine-admin delegation rule
  - confirm `/api/v1` contract still frozen
- Update **CLAUDE.md decision #12** to mention the productLine dimension (data-driven, four seeded rows) and the delegation rule.
- Update `docs/plan.md` §3 (schema) and §13 (validate matrix) for the new table, columns, partial unique indexes.
- One-liner in `docs/features.md`.

## Critical files

- `shared/db/schema/approval.ts` — new column, CHECK, partial unique indexes
- `shared/db/schema/extension.ts` — `productLines` table + `extensions.productLineId` + CHECK
- `server/repositories/reviewers.ts` — productLine-aware queries, `isCompanyAdminForSubCat`
- `server/utils/approvals.ts` — orchestrator productLineId threading
- `server/api/internal/admin/reviewers/{index.get,assign.post,unassign.delete}.ts` — `requireCellAdmin`, `canEdit` annotation
- `app/components/approvals/ReviewerMatrix.vue` (+ two new tier subcomponents)
- `app/components/approvals/RequestOfficialDialog.vue`
- `app/components/extension/ExtHero.vue`
- `app/components/filters/OfficialTierPill.vue` (+ new `ProductLinePill.vue`)
- `drizzle/0009_*.sql`

## Commit / PR split

Single feature branch + one PR. Commits per coherent unit (per CLAUDE.md workflow):

1. `feat(p9-db): add product_lines table and product_line_id columns` — migration + schema + seed, no app code yet
2. `feat(p9-repo): thread productLineId through reviewers + approvals repositories` (+ new productLines repo)
3. `feat(p9-orch): productLine-aware submit/decide orchestrator + new error codes`
4. `feat(p9-validators): require productLineId iff tier=productLine`
5. `feat(p9-api): cell-aware permission gates + product-lines endpoint`
6. `feat(p9-ui-admin): split reviewer matrix by tier with per-cell canEdit`
7. `feat(p9-ui-publish): product-line picker in RequestOfficialDialog + queue badge`
8. `feat(p9-ui-listing): inline product-line picker on filter rail + ExtHero label`
9. `test(p9): repository + orchestrator + e2e coverage for productLine dimension`
10. `docs(p9): update ADR-0001 addendum, CLAUDE.md #12, docs/plan.md, features.md`

Collapse adjacent commits if the diff is trivial — one per coherent unit, not one per phase.

## Verification

After `bun run db:migrate` + `bun run db:seed` (seed needs a tweak in commit #1 so productLine reviewer rows pick a default productLine):

1. Sign in as a company admin of `cloud` (non-superAdmin). Open `/en/admin/reviewers`. Confirm: Company tab — only the `cloud` row editable; Product-Line tab — `(cloud × {wireless,datacom,terminals,cloud})` editable, every other row greyed.
2. Assign a new reviewer to `(productLine, cloud, wireless)`. Direct POST against `(productLine, network, wireless)` returns 403 `not_authorized`.
3. As the just-assigned reviewer, open `/en/admin/approvals` (empty queue).
4. As a publisher, submit `RequestOfficialDialog` with tier=productLine, subCat=cloud, productLine=wireless.
5. Back as the reviewer, the row appears with the Wireless badge; approve.
6. `/en/extensions/<slug>` hero shows **"Wireless Official"** (EN) / **"无线官方"** (ZH).
7. `GET /api/v1/extensions/<slug>` returns `badge: "official"`, no `productLineId` leak.
8. `/en/extensions?tier=productLine&productLineId=wireless` lists the just-approved extension; the productLine pill rail appears only when `tier=productLine`.
9. Negative: same company admin tries to DELETE a Company-tier reviewer assignment (even in their own subCat) → 403.

import { resolve } from "node:path"

import { defineConfig } from "drizzle-kit"

const envPath = resolve(".env")
if (existsSync(envPath)) {
  const content = readFileSync(envPath, "utf-8")
  for (const line of content.split("\n")) {
    const match = line.match(/^([A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*)=(.*)$/)
    if (match && !process.env[match[1]]) {
      process.env[match[1]] = match[2].replace(/^["']|["']$/g, "")

  }
}

const databaseUrl = process.env.DATABASE_URL
if (!databaseUrl) {

{
  "file_path": "/Users/hutusi/workspace/ai/naive/agentcenter-nuxt/shared/db/schema/approval.ts",
  "content": "import { sql } from \"drizzle-orm\";\nimport {\n  check,\n  index,\n  pgEnum,\n  pgTable,\n  text,\n  timestamp,\n  uniqueIndex,\n} from \"drizzle-orm/pg-core\";\n\nimport { users } from \"./auth\";\nimport { extensions, officialTierEnum, productLines } from \"./extension\";\n\nexport const approvalStatusEnum = pgEnum(\"approval_status\", [\n  \"pending\",\n  \"approved\",\n  \"rejected\",\n  \"withdrawn\",\n]);\n\nexport const approvalRequests = pgTable(\n  \"approval_requests\",\n  {\n    id: text().primaryKey(),\n    extensionId: text()\n      .notNull()\n      .references(() => extensions.id, { onDelete: \"cascade\" }),\n    requestedTier: officialTierEnum().notNull(),\n    // Snapshot of the functional subCat at submission time. Source of truth is\n    // FUNC_TAXONOMY in shared/taxonomy.ts; validated against the flattened l1\n    // key set at the validator layer.\n    subCat: text().notNull(),\n    // Product line snapshot — required iff requestedTier='productLine'.\n    // RESTRICT on delete keeps the audit trail honest: a product line cannot\n    // disappear while requests still reference it.\n    productLineId: text().references(() => productLines.id, {\n      onDelete: \"restrict\",\n    }),\n    requestedByUserId: text()\n      .notNull()\n      .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: \"cascade\" }),\n    reason: text(),\n    status: approvalStatusEnum().notNull().default(\"pending\"),\n    decidedByUserId: text().references(() => users.id, {\n      onDelete: \"set null\",\n    }),\n    decidedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }),\n    reviewerNote: text(),\n    createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),\n    updatedAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),\n  },\n  (t) => [\n    // Reviewer queue: pending rows in a given cell, ordered by createdAt.\n    // productLineId trails so company-tier rows (productLineId IS NULL) still\n    // collapse onto the same prefix; productLine-tier scans use the full key.\n    index(\"idx_approval_status_cell\").on(\n      t.status,\n      t.subCat,\n      t.requestedTier,\n      t.productLineId,\n    ),\n    // Publisher \"my requests\" view and the at-most-one-pending guard.\n    index(\"idx_approval_ext_status\").on(t.extensionId, t.status),\n    // Shape invariant: productLineId is present iff requestedTier='productLine'.\n    check(\n      \"approval_requests_pl_shape_chk\",\n      sql`(requested_tier = 'productLine' AND product_line_id IS NOT NULL)\n        OR (requested_tier = 'company' AND product_line_id IS NULL)`,\n    ),\n  ],\n);\n\nexport const approvalReviewers = pgTable(\n  \"approval_reviewers\",\n  {\n    id: text().primaryKey(),\n    tier: officialTierEnum().notNull(),\n    // Same FUNC_TAXONOMY l1 key as approvalRequests.subCat — text rather\n    // than enum so adding a taxonomy leaf doesn't require a migration.\n    subCat: text().notNull(),\n    // Product line this reviewer is scoped to. Required iff tier='productLine',\n    // null when tier='company'. CHECK enforces the shape; the unique behaviour\n    // for each tier is expressed below as two partial indexes.\n    productLineId: text().references(() => productLines.id, {\n      onDelete: \"restrict\",\n    }),\n    userId: text()\n      .notNull()\n      .references(() => users.id, { onDelete: \"cascade\" }),\n    createdAt: timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),\n  },\n  (t) => [\n    // Tier-aware uniqueness. ProductLine cells include productLineId in the\n    // key; company cells do not. Two partial indexes are clearer than relying\n    // on NULLS NOT DISTINCT and let each tier's arity stand on its own.\n    uniqueIndex(\"approval_reviewers_pl_cell_user_uq\")\n      .on(t.tier, t.subCat, t.productLineId, t.userId)\n      .where(sql`tier = 'productLine'`),\n    uniqueIndex(\"approval_reviewers_co_cell_user_uq\")\n      .on(t.tier, t.subCat, t.userId)\n      .where(sql`tier = 'company'`),\n    index(\"idx_approval_reviewers_cell\").on(\n      t.tier,\n      t.subCat,\n      t.productLineId,\n    ),\n    // Shape invariant: productLineId is present iff tier='productLine'.\n    check(\n      \"approval_reviewers_pl_shape_chk\",\n      sql`(tier = 'productLine' AND product_line_id IS NOT NULL)\n        OR (tier = 'company' AND product_line_id IS NULL)`,\n    ),\n  ],\n);\n"
}

  "content": "// Dev-seed reviewer matrix for the approval workflow. Each row maps a\n// (tier, subCat, productLineId?) cell to one or more reviewer emails. For\n// productLine-tier cells productLineId is required; for company-tier cells\n// it must be omitted (the DB CHECK enforces both). The seed script\n// resolves emails to user ids against the rows it just inserted, so the\n// emails here must match `CREATORS` in `scripts/seed.ts`. Real prod\n// assignment happens through the matrix UI.\n//\n// Spread the assignments so every cell has at least one reviewer and the\n// reviewer-queue page has non-empty content under each demo persona.\n\nexport type SeedProductLine = \"wireless\" | \"datacom\" | \"terminals\" | \"cloud\"\n\nexport const APPROVAL_REVIEWERS: ReadonlyArray<{\n  tier: \"productLine\" | \"company\"\n  subCat: string\n  productLineId?: SeedProductLine\n  reviewerEmail: string\n}> = [\n  // Product-Line tier: per-(subCat × productLine) lieutenants. We fan each\n  // subCat's reviewer across all four product lines so every cell of the\n  // 9×4 grid has someone to take the page on a fresh seed.\n  ...([\"wireless\", \"datacom\", \"terminals\", \"cloud\"] as const).flatMap(\n    (pl): ReadonlyArray<{\n      tier: \"productLine\"\n      subCat: string\n      productLineId: SeedProductLine\n      reviewerEmail: string\n    }> => [\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"systemDesign\", productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"amy@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"softDev\",      productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"ben@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"testing\",      productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"ben@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"network\",      productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"cory@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"embedded\",     productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"cory@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"cloud\",        productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"dao@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"docs\",         productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"eli@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"data\",         productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"eli@agentcenter.dev\" },\n      { tier: \"productLine\", subCat: \"vcs\",          productLineId: pl, reviewerEmail: \"fei@agentcenter.dev\" },\n    ],\n  ),\n\n  // Company tier: a smaller circle of senior reviewers. Per the delegation\n  // rule, these are also the people who can manage productLine reviewers in\n  // the same subCat (see ADR-0001 2026-06-08 addendum).\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"systemDesign\", reviewerEmail: \"amy@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"softDev\",      reviewerEmail: \"amy@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"testing\",      reviewerEmail: \"amy@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"network\",      reviewerEmail: \"dao@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"embedded\",     reviewerEmail: \"dao@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"cloud\",        reviewerEmail: \"dao@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"docs\",         reviewerEmail: \"fei@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"data\",         reviewerEmail: \"fei@agentcenter.dev\" },\n  { tier: \"company\", subCat: \"vcs\",          reviewerEmail: \"fei@agentcenter.dev\" },\n]\n\n// First entry in `CREATORS` (amy) gets the super-admin membership unless\n// `SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL` overrides at runtime.\nexport const DEFAULT_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL = \"amy@agentcenter.dev\"\n"
}

The\n  // DB CHECK enforces productLineId presence per tier; we mirror it here so a\n  // bad shape in the seed file fails loudly instead of at INSERT time.\n  const reviewerRows = APPROVAL_REVIEWERS.flatMap((r, i) => {\n    const reviewer = CREATORS.find((u) => u.email === r.reviewerEmail)\n    if (!reviewer) {\n      console.warn(\n        `seed: approval reviewer email ${r.reviewerEmail} did not match any creator — skipping`,\n      )\n      return []\n    }\n    const requiresPl = r.tier === \"productLine\"\n    if (requiresPl && !r.productLineId) {\n      console.warn(\n        `seed: approval reviewer #${i} (${r.tier}/${r.subCat}) missing productLineId — skipping`,\n      )\n      return []\n    }\n    if (!requiresPl && r.productLineId) {\n      console.warn(\n        `seed: approval reviewer #${i} (${r.tier}/${r.subCat}) carries productLineId on a company-tier row — skipping`,\n      )\n      return []\n    }\n    return [\n      {\n        id: `appr-rev-${i}`,\n        tier: r.tier,\n        subCat: r.subCat,\n        productLineId: r.productLineId ?? null,\n        userId: reviewer.id,\n      },\n    ]\n  })"
}

3	import type { OfficialTier } from "~~/shared/approvals/state"
4	import {
5	  approvalReviewers,
6	  memberships,
7	  users,
8	} from "~~/shared/db/schema"
9	
10	import type { Transactable } from "./types"
11	
12	// `approval_reviewers` table accessor. Backs the reviewer matrix:
13	// (tier × subCat) → list of users assigned to decide on that cell.
14	// Also exposes the super-admin lookup used by the admin guards.
15	
16	export type { OfficialTier }
17	
18	export interface ReviewerRow {
19	  id: string
20	  tier: OfficialTier
21	  subCat: string
22	  userId: string
23	  userEmail: string
24	  userName: string | null
25	  createdAt: Date
26	}
27	
28	export interface InsertReviewerRow {
29	  id: string
30	  tier: OfficialTier
31	  subCat: string
32	  userId: string
33	}
34	
35	// Full matrix view, joined with `users` so the matrix UI can render
36	// reviewer chips with a recognisable label without an extra round-trip.
37	export async function listMatrix(db: Transactable): Promise<ReviewerRow[]> {
38	  return db
39	    .select({
40	      id: approvalReviewers.id,
41	      tier: approvalReviewers.tier,
42	      subCat: approvalReviewers.subCat,
43	      userId: approvalReviewers.userId,
44	      userEmail: users.email,
45	      userName: users.name,
46	      createdAt: approvalReviewers.createdAt,
47	    })
48	    .from(approvalReviewers)
49	    .innerJoin(users, eq(users.id, approvalReviewers.userId))
50	    .orderBy(
51	      asc(approvalReviewers.tier),
52	      asc(approvalReviewers.subCat),
53	      asc(users.email),
54	    )
55	}
56	
57	// Cells (tier × subCat) where the given user is assigned. Used by the
58	// orchestrator to drive `listPendingForCells` from `approvals.ts`.
59	export async function listCellsForUser(
60	  db: Transactable,
61	  userId: string,
62	): Promise<Array<{ tier: OfficialTier; subCat: string }>> {
63	  return db
64	    .select({
65	      tier: approvalReviewers.tier,
66	      subCat: approvalReviewers.subCat,
67	    })
68	    .from(approvalReviewers)
69	    .where(eq(approvalReviewers.userId, userId))
70	}
71	
72	// Per-cell reviewer list — useful for the orchestrator's notification fan-out.
73	export async function findReviewersFor(
74	  db: Transactable,
75	  tier: OfficialTier,
76	  subCat: string,
77	): Promise<string[]> {
78	  const rows = await db
79	    .select({ userId: approvalReviewers.userId })
80	    .from(approvalReviewers)
81	    .where(
82	      and(
83	        eq(approvalReviewers.tier, tier),
84	        eq(approvalReviewers.subCat, subCat),
85	      ),
86	    )
87	  return rows.map((r) => r.userId)
88	}
89	
90	export async function insertReviewer(
91	  db: Transactable,
92	  row: InsertReviewerRow,
93	): Promise<void> {
94	  await db.insert(approvalReviewers).values(row).onConflictDoNothing({
95	    target: [
96	      approvalReviewers.tier,
97	      approvalReviewers.subCat,
98	      approvalReviewers.userId,
99	    ],
100	  })
101	}
102	
103	export async function deleteReviewer(
104	  db: Transactable,
105	  id: string,
106	): Promise<void> {
107	  await db.delete(approvalReviewers).where(eq(approvalReviewers.id, id))
108	}

110	// Super-admin check. A user is a super-admin if any of their memberships
111	// carries the `superAdmin` role. Decoupled from a specific org so seeded
112	// super-admins keep their authority even when the default org is renamed.
113	export async function isSuperAdmin(

187	      ),

189	    .returning({ id: approvalRequests.id })
190	  return updated.length

Used by the\n// publisher submit dialog, the reviewer matrix UI, and the listing-page\n// product-line filter pill. The list is small (4 rows today) and changes\n// rarely, so callers can safely cache the result for the request lifetime.\n\nexport interface ProductLineRow {\n  id: string\n  labelEn: string\n  labelZh: string\n  sortOrder: number\n}\n\nexport async function listAllProductLines(\n  db: Transactable,\n): Promise<ProductLineRow[]> {\n  return db\n    .select({\n      id: productLines.id,\n      labelEn: productLines.labelEn,\n      labelZh: productLines.labelZh,\n      sortOrder: productLines.sortOrder,\n    })\n    .from(productLines)\n    .orderBy(asc(productLines.sortOrder), asc(productLines.id))\n}\n\n// Existence check for validators that have already pattern-matched the id\n// but still need to confirm membership against the seeded set.\nexport async function existsProductLine(\n  db: Transactable,\n  id: string,\n): Promise<boolean> {\n  const [row] = await db\n    .select({ id: productLines.id })\n    .from(productLines)\n    .where(eq(productLines.id, id))\n    .limit(1)\n  return !!row\n}\n"
}

14	// Orchestrators over the approvals/reviewers/extensions repositories. Pure
15	// transitions live in `shared/approvals/state.ts`; this file loads rows,
16	// opens transactions, fires Inngest events, and maps domain errors to
17	// HTTP-shaped codes the endpoints translate.

19	export type ApprovalErrorCode =
20	  | "extension_not_found"
21	  | "not_publisher_owner"
22	  | "extension_not_published"
23	  | "request_not_found"
24	  | "request_not_pending"
25	  | "duplicate_pending_request"
26	  | "not_reviewer"
27	  | "not_requester"

29	export class ApprovalError extends Error {
30	  readonly code: ApprovalErrorCode
31	  constructor(code: ApprovalErrorCode) {
32	    super(code)
33	    this.code = code
34	    this.name = "ApprovalError"
35	  }
36	}

38	export interface SubmitParams {
39	  extensionId: string
40	  requestedTier: OfficialTier
41	  subCat: string
42	  userId: string
43	  reason: string | undefined
44	}
45	
46	export async function submitRequest(
47	  params: SubmitParams,
48	): Promise<approvalsRepo.ApprovalRequestRow> {
49	  const db = useDb()
50	
51	  const ext = await extensionsRepo.findById(db, params.extensionId)
52	  if (!ext) throw new ApprovalError("extension_not_found")
53	  if (ext.publisherUserId !== params.userId) {
54	    throw new ApprovalError("not_publisher_owner")
55	  }
56	  if (ext.visibility !== "published") {
57	    throw new ApprovalError("extension_not_published")
58	  }
59	
60	  const row = await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
61	    // Re-check inside the transaction — race window between the visibility
62	    // load above and the insert below would otherwise let a duplicate slip
63	    // through. PG isolation is `read committed` so the second check still
64	    // sees a concurrent insert that already committed.
65	    const existing = await approvalsRepo.findPendingByExtension(
66	      tx,
67	      params.extensionId,
68	    )
69	    if (existing) throw new ApprovalError("duplicate_pending_request")
70	
71	    return approvalsRepo.insertRequest(tx, {
72	      id: crypto.randomUUID(),
73	      extensionId: params.extensionId,
74	      requestedTier: params.requestedTier,
75	      subCat: params.subCat,
76	      requestedByUserId: params.userId,
77	      reason: params.reason ?? null,
78	    })
79	  })
80	
81	  await inngest.send({
82	    name: "extension/approval.requested",
83	    data: {
84	      requestId: row.id,
85	      extensionId: row.extensionId,
86	      requestedTier: row.requestedTier,
87	      subCat: row.subCat,
88	      requesterUserId: row.requestedByUserId,
89	    },
90	  })
91	
92	  return row
93	}

95	export interface DecideParams {
96	  requestId: string
97	  action: ApprovalAction
98	  reviewerUserId: string
99	}
100	
101	export async function decideRequest(
102	  params: DecideParams,
103	): Promise<approvalsRepo.ApprovalRequestRow> {
104	  const db = useDb()
105	
106	  const current = await approvalsRepo.findById(db, params.requestId)
107	  if (!current) throw new ApprovalError("request_not_found")
108	  if (current.status !== "pending") {
109	    throw new ApprovalError("request_not_pending")
110	  }
111	
112	  // Super-admins can decide on any cell; otherwise the reviewer must be
113	  // assigned to (requestedTier, subCat) on this request.
114	  const allowed =
115	    (await reviewersRepo.isSuperAdmin(db, params.reviewerUserId)) ||
116	    (await approvalsRepo.isReviewerForCell(
117	      db,
118	      params.reviewerUserId,
119	      current.requestedTier,
120	      current.subCat,
121	    ))
122	  if (!allowed) throw new ApprovalError("not_reviewer")
123	
124	  const outcome = decideApprovalOutcome({
125	    current: {
126	      status: current.status,
127	      requestedTier: current.requestedTier,
128	    },
129	    action: params.action,
130	    reviewerUserId: params.reviewerUserId,
131	    now: new Date(),
132	  })
133	
134	  // Optimistic locking lives inside the repository's UPDATE — if a second
135	  // reviewer decided between the pre-check above and this transaction, the
136	  // affected row count comes back zero and we surface the race as
137	  // `request_not_pending`.
138	  await db.transaction(async (tx) => {
139	    const updated = await approvalsRepo.applyDecision(
140	      tx,
141	      params.requestId,
142	      outcome.request,
143	    )
144	    if (updated === 0) throw new ApprovalError("request_not_pending")
145	    if (outcome.extension) {
146	      await approvalsRepo.setExtensionOfficialTier(
147	        tx,
148	        current.extensionId,
149	        outcome.extension.officialTier,
150	      )
151	    }
152	  })
153	
154	  const updated = await approvalsRepo.findById(db, params.requestId)
155	  if (!updated) throw new Error("approval request vanished mid-decide")
156	
157	  await inngest.send({
158	    name: "extension/approval.decided",
159	    data: {
160	      requestId: updated.id,
161	      extensionId: updated.extensionId,
162	      decision: outcome.request.status,
163	      decidedByUserId: params.reviewerUserId,
164	    },
165	  })
166	
167	  return updated
168	}

170	export interface WithdrawParams {
171	  requestId: string
172	  userId: string
173	}
174	
175	export async function withdrawRequest(
176	  params: WithdrawParams,
177	): Promise<approvalsRepo.ApprovalRequestRow> {
178	  const db = useDb()
179	
180	  const current = await approvalsRepo.findById(db, params.requestId)
181	  if (!current) throw new ApprovalError("request_not_found")
182	  if (current.requestedByUserId !== params.userId) {
183	    throw new ApprovalError("not_requester")
184	  }
185	  if (current.status !== "pending") {
186	    throw new ApprovalError("request_not_pending")
187	  }
188	
189	  const outcome = decideWithdrawOutcome({
190	    current: { status: current.status },
191	    now: new Date(),
192	  })
193	  const affected = await approvalsRepo.applyWithdraw(
194	    db,
195	    params.requestId,
196	    outcome.request.decidedAt,
197	  )
198	  if (affected === 0) throw new ApprovalError("request_not_pending")
199	
200	  const updated = await approvalsRepo.findById(db, params.requestId)
201	  if (!updated) throw new Error("approval request vanished mid-withdraw")
202	  return updated
203	}

205	// Reviewer queue — pending requests in any cell this user covers. Returns
206	// an empty array when the user has no cell assignments (and is not a
207	// super-admin); super-admins see the whole pending queue.
208	export async function listReviewerQueue(
209	  userId: string,
210	): Promise<approvalsRepo.ApprovalRequestRow[]> {
211	  const db = useDb()
212	  if (await reviewersRepo.isSuperAdmin(db, userId)) {
213	    // Treat super-admin as "assigned to every cell". Pulled from the
214	    // matrix verbatim so an empty matrix still surfaces no rows — better
215	    // than a silent firehose.
216	    const cells = await reviewersRepo
217	      .listMatrix(db)
218	      .then((rows) =>
219	        Array.from(
220	          new Set(rows.map((r) => `${r.tier}:${r.subCat}`)),
221	        ).map((k) => {
222	          const [tier, subCat] = k.split(":") as [OfficialTier, string]
223	          return { tier, subCat }
224	        }),
225	      )
226	    return approvalsRepo.listPendingForCells(db, cells)
227	  }
228	
229	  const cells = await reviewersRepo.listCellsForUser(db, userId)
230	  return approvalsRepo.listPendingForCells(db, cells)
231	}

1	import { z } from "zod";
2	
3	const CATEGORIES = ["skills", "mcp", "slash", "plugins"] as const;
4	const SCOPES = ["personal", "org", "enterprise"] as const;
5	const FUNC_CATS = ["workTask", "business", "tools"] as const;
6	const FILTER_CHIPS = ["all", "trending", "new", "official", "free"] as const;
7	const TIERS = ["unofficial", "productLine", "company"] as const;
8	const SORTS = ["downloads", "stars", "recent"] as const;
9	const TAG_MATCHES = ["any", "all"] as const;
10	
11	export const PAGE_SIZE = 24;
12	
13	export const filtersSchema = z.object({
14	  q: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120).optional(),
15	  category: z.enum(CATEGORIES).optional(),
16	  scope: z.enum(SCOPES).optional(),
17	  funcCat: z.enum(FUNC_CATS).optional(),
18	  subCat: z.string().trim().min(1).max(40).optional(),
19	  l2: z.string().trim().min(1).max(40).optional(),
20	  // Department id (dotted-path) or the literal "__all" to disable the filter.
21	  dept: z.string().trim().min(1).max(120).optional(),
22	  // Creator = users.id (the user who published). Schema column is named
23	  // publisherUserId for legacy reasons; we expose it as "creator" everywhere.
24	  creator: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80).optional(),
25	  // Publisher = organizations.id (the owning org).
26	  publisher: z.string().trim().min(1).max(80).optional(),
27	  tags: z.array(z.string().trim().min(1).max(40)).max(16).optional(),
28	  tagMatch: z.enum(TAG_MATCHES).optional(),
29	  filter: z.enum(FILTER_CHIPS).optional(),
30	  // Three-state official-tier filter: 'unofficial' | 'productLine' | 'company'.
31	  // Separate from the legacy `filter=official` chip (which now means "any
32	  // official tier"); `tier=` picks a specific cell.
33	  tier: z.enum(TIERS).optional(),
34	  sort: z.enum(SORTS).optional(),
35	  page: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1000).optional(),
36	});
37	
38	export type Filters = z.infer<typeof filtersSchema>;
39	
40	/**
41	 * Parse Next.js searchParams into typed Filters. Invalid input is dropped,
42	 * so a malformed URL silently falls back to "no filter" rather than 500ing.
43	 */
44	export function parseFilters(
45	  input: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>,
46	): Filters {
47	  const tags = input.tags;
48	  const normalized = {
49	    ...input,
50	    tags:
51	      tags === undefined
52	        ? undefined
53	        : Array.isArray(tags)
54	          ? tags
55	          : tags.split(",").filter(Boolean),
56	  };
57	  const parsed = filtersSchema.safeParse(normalized);
58	  return parsed.success ? parsed.data : {};
59	}
60	
61	export function pageOffset(page: number | undefined) {
62	  return ((page ?? 1) - 1) * PAGE_SIZE;
63	}
64	
65	/**
66	 * Adapter from `URLSearchParams` (the runtime shape) to the `Record` shape
67	 * `parseFilters` consumes. Repeated keys (`?tags=a&tags=b`) accumulate into
68	 * an array; `serializeFilters` always emits comma-joined, but external
69	 * links may use the array form and the validator already handles both.
70	 */
71	export function searchParamsToInput(
72	  searchParams: URLSearchParams,
73	): Record<string, string | string[]> {
74	  const out: Record<string, string | string[]> = {};
75	  for (const [key, value] of searchParams.entries()) {
76	    const prev = out[key];
77	    if (prev === undefined) {
78	      out[key] = value;
79	    } else if (Array.isArray(prev)) {
80	      prev.push(value);
81	    } else {
82	      out[key] = [prev, value];
83	    }
84	  }
85	  return out;
86	}
87	
88	/**
89	 * Inverse of `parseFilters`. Encodes typed filters back into URL search
90	 * params using the same conventions parseFilters consumes — comma-joined
91	 * arrays for `tags`, omitted keys for undefined / empty values.
92	 */
93	export function serializeFilters(filters: Partial<Filters>): URLSearchParams {
94	  const params = new URLSearchParams();
95	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(filters)) {
96	    if (value === undefined || value === "" || value === null) continue;
97	    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
98	      if (value.length > 0) params.set(key, value.join(","));
99	    } else {
100	      params.set(key, String(value));
101	    }
102	  }
103	  return params;
104	}
105

11	} from "~~/shared/db/schema/auth"

14	
15	function makeAuth() {
16	  const db = useDb()
17	  return betterAuth({
18	    database: drizzleAdapter(db, {
19	      provider: "pg",
20	      schema: {
21	        user: users,
22	        session: sessions,
23	        account: accounts,
24	        verification: verifications,
25	      },
26	    }),
27	    emailAndPassword: { enabled: true },
28	    user: {
29	      additionalFields: {
30	        locale: {
31	          type: "string",
32	          required: false,
33	          defaultValue: "en",
34	          input: false,
35	        },
36	        themePreference: {
37	          type: "string",
38	          required: false,
39	          defaultValue: "ivory",
40	          input: false,
41	        },
42	        defaultDeptId: {
43	          type: "string",
44	          required: false,
45	          input: false,
46	        },
47	      },
48	    },
49	  })
50	}
51	
52	type AuthInstance = ReturnType<typeof makeAuth>
53	
54	let _auth: AuthInstance | undefined
55	
56	export function useAuthServer(): AuthInstance {
57	  if (!_auth) _auth = makeAuth()
58	  return _auth
59	}
60	
61	type SessionPayload = Awaited<
62	  ReturnType<AuthInstance["api"]["getSession"]>
63	>
64	export type SessionUser = NonNullable<SessionPayload>["user"]
65	
66	function toFetchHeaders(raw: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>): Headers {
67	  const headers = new Headers()
68	  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(raw)) {
69	    if (value === undefined) continue
70	    headers.append(key, Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : value)
71	  }
72	  return headers
73	}
74	
75	export async function getSessionUser(event: H3Event): Promise<SessionUser | null> {
76	  const auth = useAuthServer()
77	  const session = await auth.api.getSession({
78	    headers: toFetchHeaders(getRequestHeaders(event)),
79	  })
80	  return session?.user ?? null
81	}
82	
83	export async function requireUser(event: H3Event): Promise<SessionUser> {
84	  const user = await getSessionUser(event)
85	  if (!user) {
86	    throw createError({ statusCode: 401, statusMessage: "Unauthenticated" })
87	  }
88	  return user
89	}

96	export async function requireSuperAdmin(event: H3Event): Promise<SessionUser> {
97	  const user = await requireUser(event)
98	  if (!(await isSuperAdmin(useDb(), user.id))) {
99	    throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: "Forbidden" })
100	  }
101	  return user

Returns the\n// session user when they hold any membership with role='superAdmin';\n// throws 401 when unauthenticated and 403 otherwise. The membership\n// lookup goes through the reviewers repo so the policy lives in one\n// place — see `server/repositories/reviewers.ts`.\nexport async function requireSuperAdmin(event: H3Event): Promise<SessionUser> {\n  const user = await requireUser(event)\n  if (!(await isSuperAdmin(useDb(), user.id))) {\n    throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: \"Forbidden\" })\n  }\n  return user\n}\n\n// Cell-aware authorisation for matrix edits. Encodes the delegation rule\n// from ADR-0001 (2026-06-08 addendum):\n//   - super-admins can edit every cell;\n//   - company-tier admins of subCat X may manage productLine cells of\n//     subCat X (any productLine);\n//   - company-tier cells stay super-admin-only.\n// Callers pass the cell coordinates explicitly — for `unassign`, load the\n// target row first so the gate authorises against that row's coordinates\n// rather than the caller's request body.\nexport async function requireCellAdmin(\n  event: H3Event,\n  cell: { tier: OfficialTier; subCat: string; productLineId: string | null },\n): Promise<SessionUser> {\n  const user = await requireUser(event)\n  const db = useDb()\n  if (await isSuperAdmin(db, user.id)) return user\n  if (\n    cell.tier === \"productLine\" &&\n    (await isCompanyAdminForSubCat(db, user.id, cell.subCat))\n  ) {\n    return user\n  }\n  throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: \"not_authorized\" })\n}"
}

The access gate widens from\n// \"super-admin only\" to \"super-admin OR any company-tier reviewer\" — the\n// non-super viewer sees the full read-only matrix and can only mutate\n// productLine cells in their own subCats (see requireCellAdmin).\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) => {\n  const user = await requireUser(event)\n  const db = useDb()\n  const [superAdmin, companySubCats] = await Promise.all([\n    isSuperAdmin(db, user.id),\n    listCompanySubCatsForUser(db, user.id),\n  ])\n  const isCompanyAdmin = companySubCats.length > 0\n  if (!superAdmin && !isCompanyAdmin) {\n    throw createError({ statusCode: 403, statusMessage: \"Forbidden\" })\n  }\n\n  const editableSubCats = new Set(companySubCats)\n  const [reviewers, productLines] = await Promise.all([\n    listMatrix(db),\n    listAllProductLines(db),\n  ])\n\n  return {\n    ok: true,\n    productLines,\n    reviewers: reviewers.map((r) => ({\n      ...r,\n      canEdit:\n        superAdmin ||\n        (r.tier === \"productLine\" && editableSubCats.has(r.subCat)),\n    })),\n    viewer: {\n      isSuperAdmin: superAdmin,\n      companySubCats,\n    },\n  }\n})\n"
}

1	// Gate the /admin/reviewers page. Requires the caller to hold a
2	// `superAdmin` membership. Authentication is enforced separately via
3	// `require-auth` — apply this middleware after it.
4	export default defineNuxtRouteMiddleware(async () => {
5	  const localePath = useLocalePath()
6	  try {
7	    const headers = import.meta.server
8	      ? useRequestHeaders(["cookie"])
9	      : {}
10	    const me = await $fetch("/api/internal/admin/me", {
11	      headers: headers as Record<string, string>,

14	      return navigateTo(localePath("/"))

Cells where the viewer is\n// not authorised render their controls disabled — typically a company\n// admin of subCat X only edits the row for X.\n\nexport interface ProductLineReviewerRow {\n  id: string\n  subCat: string\n  productLineId: string\n  userId: string\n  userEmail: string\n  userName: string | null\n  canEdit: boolean\n}\n\nexport interface ProductLine {\n  id: string\n  labelEn: string\n  labelZh: string\n  sortOrder: number\n}\n\nconst props = defineProps<{\n  reviewers: ProductLineReviewerRow[]\n  productLines: ProductLine[]\n  viewerCompanySubCats: string[]\n}>()\nconst emit = defineEmits<{ (e: \"refresh\"): void }>()\n\nconst { t, locale } = useI18n()\n\nconst subCats = computed(() =>\n  FUNC_TAXONOMY.flatMap((cat) => cat.l1.map((leaf) => leaf.key)),\n)\n\nconst orderedLines = computed(() =>\n  [...props.productLines].sort((a, b) => a.sortOrder - b.sortOrder),\n)\n\nfunction lineLabel(line: ProductLine): string {\n  return locale.value === \"zh\" ? line.labelZh : line.labelEn\n}\n\nconst cells = computed<Record<string, ProductLineReviewerRow[]>>(() => {\n  const out: Record<string, ProductLineReviewerRow[]> = {}\n  for (const r of props.reviewers) {\n    const key = `${r.subCat}::${r.productLineId}`\n    if (!out[key]) out[key] = []\n    out[key]!.push(r)\n  }\n  return out\n})\n\nfunction reviewersFor(subCat: string, productLineId: string): ProductLineReviewerRow[] {\n  return cells.value[`${subCat}::${productLineId}`] ?? []\n}\n\nconst viewerIsSuperAdmin = inject<Ref<boolean>>(\"viewerIsSuperAdmin\", ref(false))\n\n// A cell is editable when the viewer is a super-admin OR is a company\n// admin of the cell's subCat. We mirror the server's `requireCellAdmin`\n// so the UI can decide before issuing a request.\nfunction canEditCell(subCat: string): boolean {\n  return (\n    viewerIsSuperAdmin.value ||\n    props.viewerCompanySubCats.includes(subCat)\n  )\n}\n\ninterface EditingCell {\n  subCat: string\n  productLineId: string\n}\nconst editingCell = ref<EditingCell | null>(null)\nconst newEmail = ref(\"\")\nconst lookupError = ref<string | null>(null)\nconst busy = ref(false)\n\nfunction openAdd(subCat: string, productLineId: string) {\n  if (!canEditCell(subCat)) return\n  editingCell.value = { subCat, productLineId }\n  newEmail.value = \"\"\n  lookupError.value = null\n}\n\nfunction closeAdd() {\n  editingCell.value = null\n  newEmail.value = \"\"\n  lookupError.value = null\n}\n\nfunction lineForId(id: string): ProductLine | undefined {\n  return props.productLines.find((l) => l.id === id)\n}\n\nasync function addReviewer() {\n  if (!editingCell.value || busy.value) return\n  const email = newEmail.value.trim()\n  if (!email) return\n  busy.value = true\n  lookupError.value = null\n  try {\n    const { user } = await $fetch(\"/api/internal/admin/users/by-email\", {\n      query: { email },\n    })\n    if (!user) {\n      lookupError.value = t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.noSuchUser\")\n      return\n    }\n    await $fetch(\"/api/internal/admin/reviewers/assign\", {\n      method: \"POST\",\n      body: {\n        tier: \"productLine\",\n        subCat: editingCell.value.subCat,\n        productLineId: editingCell.value.productLineId,\n        userId: user.id,\n      },\n    })\n    closeAdd()\n    emit(\"refresh\")\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"[reviewers] add failed\", err)\n    lookupError.value = t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.genericError\")\n  } finally {\n    busy.value = false\n  }\n}\n\nasync function removeReviewer(row: ProductLineReviewerRow) {\n  if (busy.value || !row.canEdit) return\n  busy.value = true\n  try {\n    await $fetch(\"/api/internal/admin/reviewers/unassign\", {\n      method: \"DELETE\",\n      body: { id: row.id },\n    })\n    emit(\"refresh\")\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.error(\"[reviewers] remove failed\", err)\n  } finally {\n    busy.value = false\n  }\n}\n</script>\n\n<template>\n  <div class=\"overflow-x-auto\">\n    <table class=\"w-full border-separate border-spacing-0 text-sm\">\n      <thead>\n        <tr>\n          <th class=\"sticky left-0 z-10 bg-(--color-bg) border-b border-(--color-border) py-2 px-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-(--color-ink-muted)\">\n            {{ t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.subCatColumn\") }}\n          </th>\n          <th\n            v-for=\"line in orderedLines\"\n            :key=\"line.id\"\n            class=\"border-b border-(--color-border) py-2 px-3 text-left text-xs font-semibold text-(--color-ink)\"\n          >\n            {{ lineLabel(line) }}\n          </th>\n        </tr>\n      </thead>\n      <tbody>\n        <tr v-for=\"subCat in subCats\" :key=\"subCat\">\n          <th\n            scope=\"row\"\n            class=\"sticky left-0 z-10 bg-(--color-bg) border-b border-(--color-border) py-3 px-3 text-left font-medium text-(--color-ink)\"\n            :class=\"canEditCell(subCat) ? '' : 'opacity-60'\"\n          >\n            {{ t(`taxonomy.l1.${subCat}`) }}\n          </th>\n          <td\n            v-for=\"line in orderedLines\"\n            :key=\"`${subCat}::${line.id}`\"\n            class=\"border-b border-(--color-border) py-3 px-3 align-top\"\n            :class=\"canEditCell(subCat) ? '' : 'bg-(--color-sidebar)/30'\"\n          >\n            <ul class=\"flex flex-wrap gap-1.5\">\n              <li\n                v-for=\"r in reviewersFor(subCat, line.id)\"\n                :key=\"r.id\"\n                class=\"inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-(--color-border) bg-(--color-card) px-2 py-0.5 text-xs\"\n                :class=\"r.canEdit ? '' : 'opacity-70'\"\n              >\n                <span class=\"truncate max-w-[12rem]\" :title=\"r.userEmail\">\n                  {{ r.userName || r.userEmail }}\n                </span>\n                <button\n                  v-if=\"r.canEdit\"\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  :aria-label=\"t('admin.reviewers.matrix.removeAria', { user: r.userEmail })\"\n                  class=\"text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:text-red-600\"\n                  @click=\"removeReviewer(r)\"\n                >\n                  <X class=\"size-3\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                </button>\n              </li>\n              <li v-if=\"canEditCell(subCat)\">\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  class=\"rounded-full border border-dashed border-(--color-border) px-2 py-0.5 text-xs text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:bg-(--color-sidebar)/60\"\n                  @click=\"openAdd(subCat, line.id)\"\n                >\n                  + {{ t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.add\") }}\n                </button>\n              </li>\n            </ul>\n          </td>\n        </tr>\n      </tbody>\n    </table>\n\n    <Dialog :open=\"!!editingCell\" @update:open=\"(v) => !v && closeAdd()\">\n      <DialogContent v-if=\"editingCell\" class=\"max-w-sm\">\n        <DialogTitle class=\"font-serif text-lg text-(--color-ink)\">\n          {{ t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.addTitle\") }}\n        </DialogTitle>\n        <DialogDescription class=\"text-sm text-(--color-ink-muted)\">\n          {{\n            t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.addSubtitleProductLine\", {\n              line: lineForId(editingCell.productLineId)\n                ? lineLabel(lineForId(editingCell.productLineId)!)\n                : editingCell.productLineId,\n              subCat: t(`taxonomy.l1.${editingCell.subCat}`),\n            })\n          }}\n        </DialogDescription>\n        <div class=\"space-y-3\">\n          <Label for=\"add-pl-email\" class=\"text-xs font-medium\">\n            {{ t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.emailLabel\") }}\n          </Label>\n          <Input\n            id=\"add-pl-email\"\n            v-model=\"newEmail\"\n            type=\"email\"\n            :placeholder=\"t('admin.reviewers.matrix.emailPlaceholder')\"\n            @keydown.enter=\"addReviewer\"\n          />\n          <p v-if=\"lookupError\" class=\"text-sm text-red-600\">{{ lookupError }}</p>\n        </div>\n        <div class=\"flex items-center justify-end gap-2\">\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            class=\"text-sm text-(--color-ink-muted) hover:text-(--color-ink)\"\n            @click=\"closeAdd\"\n          >\n            {{ t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.cancel\") }}\n          </button>\n          <button\n            type=\"button\"\n            :disabled=\"busy || !newEmail.trim()\"\n            class=\"inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md bg-(--color-accent) px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-semibold text-(--color-accent-fg) hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-50\"\n            @click=\"addReviewer\"\n          >\n            <Loader2 v-if=\"busy\" class=\"size-3.5 animate-spin\" aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n            {{ t(\"admin.reviewers.matrix.confirmAdd\") }}\n          </button>\n        </div>\n      </DialogContent>\n    </Dialog>\n  </div>\n</template>\n"
}
